AstroCapture includes Astrometry.net 0.97 as separate command-line processes
for local blind solving. Astrometry.net and its linked GSL/WCSLIB libraries
are distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later / LGPL-3.0-or-later respectively.
See the accompanying license texts, including Astrometry.net-LICENSE.txt.

Contents/Resources/ThirdPartySources contains the corresponding upstream source
archives, their verified SHA256 and the installed Homebrew build recipes
for Astrometry.net and GSL. WCSLIB 8.10 is built privately from the included
archive by prepare_wcslib() in package_astrometry_sources.py. This avoids
using a Homebrew bottle whose original tarball has since been repacked upstream. The recipes document dependencies, flags and
patches. Rebuild with those recipes or the upstream build instructions. The included
packaging scripts document the private WCSLIB build and dependency deployment.
The helpers have no AstroCapture-specific source changes. Packaging copies the
native executables, changes their Mach-O dependency paths to bundled libraries,
adds @loader_path/../../Frameworks and applies ad-hoc codesigning. The public
scripts/package_macos.sh documents these deployment operations.

Images are solved locally; no index data is embedded. Index 4109 can be downloaded
from https://data.astrometry.net/4100/index-4109.fits with the official checksum.
Users can select any supported local index folder. Upstream documentation:
https://astrometry.net/doc/readme.html
https://github.com/dstndstn/astrometry.net/releases/tag/0.97
